title: OVT cache-wide index (cache.json), cache_format 1
description: Chapter 06 §6.7.1 and §6.7.4 of the OVT specification; written by core/src/cache/cache.cpp (WI-0.091, WI-0.092).

size_cap_bytes.description: size cap of the cache in bytes (§6.7.4); default 20 GiB desktop, 2 GiB Android

entries.description: one record per <source_hash>/ entry directory, sorted by source_hash

last_used.description: ISO-8601 UTC; the eviction order (oldest first)

bytes.description: sum of the sizes of every file under the entry directory, kept incrementally
